evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and implements setprunelock and listprunelocks in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
rationale: This PR adds missing RPC methods that external wallets require to prevent needed blocks from being pruned during offline periods or rescans. Reviewers confirmed strong ecosystem value, noting it is 'generally useful in the wallet and for any wallets that leverage Bitcoin Core' (achow101) and enables 'wallets to build on top of a pruned node via RPC' (stickies-v).
